name: Cinderhold
about: Muspelheim, realm of fire. Cinderhold is built on terraces down the wall of a vast caldera: black basalt houses with copper-red roofs, lava-falls pouring into glowing channels, bridges of cooled glass, forge-glow in every window and drifting ember motes. Arrival from Bifrost through the red arch; the Sigil Forge on the upper terrace; the glass bridge east to the Lavafalls.

exits.label: the glass bridge to the Lavafalls

portals.label: the red arch back to Bifrost Crossing

actors.name: Svala, spice trader
say: Spice, charms, tea. Everything sized for the small. Haggle warm.

actors.name: Orm Kettlebrand
say: She bit you? Good. Biting is how lizards say hello.

actors.name: Grettir Ashmarch
say: Contracts, tunnels, tolls. Nothing for free but the view.
